title: GOLDEN ENEMIES
why: His answer 11 a: a rare golden enemy with big loot. About half of all raids now hold one golden enemy, a machine or a hostile pillager somewhere away from where you drop in. It burns gold, is a little bigger and has three times the health. When it dies it leaves a GOLDEN HOARD with five top-tier finds. In DEMO a wave is now and then led by one. Both players see it in co-op, and the map, the enemies and the loot are otherwise exactly as before.
now: About half of all raids now hold a golden enemy: three times the health, and a golden hoard when it dies.
